//routing: HOW A ROW NAVIGATES. capture.spec.ts does page.goto(route): a HARD document GET. The fe-gateway routes /login/**, /admin/**, /mod/** and /user/** to the remote's own container (tests/stack/gateway-routes/fe/application-routes.yml:154-179, StripPrefix=1), so a hard GET to those prefixes renders the BARE remote — no host-shell header, no menubar, no home cards. Only host-shell-served URLs (/, /home, /about, and the remote-deeplink-to-host-shell prefixes — which since 2026-10-28 include /games/**, so /games and /games/admin boot the shell and the shell mounts the `games` remote) boot the shell. A row that needs shell chrome (home-services-nav, home-card-*, profile-trigger, nav-user, menu-*, nav-*, subnav-*, denied-notice) must therefore start at '/' (roleHomeGuard lands on /user client-side) or '/home', and reach a console by CLICKING home-card-nav-admin / home-card-nav-mod. Rows that hard-GET /admin/... or /mod/... and wait only on the remote's own testids DO capture, but they photograph the standalone remote — see the reconcile notes in the commit that added this comment.
//state: WHAT A ROW MAY WRITE, AND IN WHAT ORDER. Every row is an independent Playwright test that signs in afresh; capture.spec.ts runs rows in personas[] order then step order (--all: every persona in that order), and a row that fails costs exactly its own PNG - no later row is skipped for it. Most rows read, or fill and stop BEFORE the write. The rows that DO write, each a step its plan names: games-operator-14/15/17 (suspend/resume/terminate the FIRST Instances row - 'first': true - #300 line 44), image-builder-14 (grant THEN revoke ROLE_IMAGE_BUILDER: net zero; both 503 while casdoor.admin.enabled=false), curtailed-member-10 (files an appeal as e2e-user; idempotent, #311 step 10), fleet-owner-10 (mfa-choose-totp POSTs a TOTP enrolment start; #314 step 21 reverses it), anonymous-10 (forgot-request-submit), moderator-30 (mc-block; the 403 is the expected result), superadmin-13 (fe-grant; step-up refuses), games-operator-11 (gs-create; client-side validation refuses, no request). ORDERING HAZARD: curtailed-member-10 leaves a PENDING appeal, after which admin-20 (expects aa-empty, #307 step 20) fails until an admin decides it - run admin before curtailed-member (what --all does). Running a persona twice, or after another persona's writes, changes what later shots show (RECONCILE-20260916.md H8).
